data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'dardanos', which means 'firm, steadfast, or enduring'. In Greek mythology, Dardanos was the founder of the city of Dardanelles and a descendant of Zeus. This name embodies courage and strength, making it an excellent choice for a little girl. The name Darda carries the meaning “Strong, brave one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Darda usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, brave one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Darda total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
